mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase; cefuroxime contains a methyltetrazolethiol side chain that can produce a disulfiram-like reaction (flushing, nausea, vomiting) if alcohol is consumed, and theoretical additive hepatotoxic potential exists.
action: Monitor for disulfiram-like reactions if patient consumes alcohol; counsel strict alcohol avoidance; monitor liver function tests given both agents have hepatic metabolism/effects.
